vulnerability.title: Session cookie replay from a new client
vulnerability.weakness: Session cookie alone authenticates; replaying it from another IP/UA is accepted unless detectors flag the anomaly.
vulnerability.mitigation: Bind sessions to client signals; regenerate IDs; enable session detector BLOCK; use HTTPS + Secure cookies in production.

vulnerability.title: Sidejacking (stolen cookie on sensitive paths)
vulnerability.weakness: A second client reuses a captured session cookie on /home|/search|/logout.
vulnerability.mitigation: TLS everywhere, HttpOnly+Secure cookies, anomaly detection on IP/UA change.

vulnerability.title: Session fixation
vulnerability.weakness: If SESSION_REGENERATE_ON_LOGIN=False, a pre-planted session ID survives login so the attacker who knows that ID inherits the authenticated session.
vulnerability.mitigation: Always regenerate session ID on privilege change (default True).

vulnerability.title: Session ID spraying / prediction
vulnerability.weakness: High rate of guessed session cookies against authenticated paths.
vulnerability.mitigation: Cryptographically random session IDs + rate limits + session detector.
